newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ALLIANCE GAMING RAISED.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ALLIANCE GAMING RAISED.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Thursday it raised its rating on the shares of Alliance Gaming Corp to buy from accumulate.

-- Analyst Maria Vallejo said her upgrade was based on the stock's relatively cheap valuation, the company's plan to enter the progressive slot machine market and its upcoming introduction of proprietary games.
-- "Together, these two factors -- the progressive slot market and the proprietary games introductions -- could add another $0.10 per share to our calendar 1998 estimate."
-- Vallejo said her calendar 1998 earnings estimate was $0.30 per share.
-- Her price target was $7 per share.
